scenarios.name: Evacuee
scenarios.desc: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.

scenarios.name: 难民中心
scenarios.desc: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have made your way to a refugee center.

scenarios.name: Strange Castle
scenarios.desc: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and made your way to the wilderness.  You were expecting this area to be uninhabited, but instead you see a large castle guarded by strange robots.  At the entrance stands a sign, it reads "Traders Come Well Avaunt"

scenarios.name: Friends to the End
scenarios.desc: You and your friends always talked about what you'd do when the world ended… now it's come true, and you've made your way to a remote cabin your friend Liam always said to head for.  It's been a hell of a journey.  You hope Liam and the others made it in one piece.

scenarios.name: Squatter
scenarios.desc: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in an abandoned building.  Unfortunately, while you're the only one here now, you are definitely not the first person to be here, and in its current state this building no longer seems nearly as secu

scenarios.name: Missed
scenarios.desc: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation and are stuck in a city full of the risen dead.

scenarios.name: Large Building
scenarios.desc: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation and are stuck in a large building full of the risen dead.

scenarios.name: Surrounded
scenarios.desc: You've attracted the attention of living dead in some way, now they're all around you and you'll likely have to fight through them if you want to escape.

scenarios.name: Safe Place
scenarios.desc: You've found a safe place away from the cities and devoid of the living dead.  Looks like you're on your own…

scenarios.name: 感染
scenarios.desc: In the chaos and panic of the evacuation, you got bitten by something!  You didn't get proper medical care, and now the wound has started turning green.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Hunted
scenarios.desc: 自从大灾变开始以来，有只怪物一直在永不停歇地追杀着你。你可以跑得比它快，但它似乎总能最终找到你。唯一解脱的方式就是你们当中死一个。

scenarios.name: Challenge - Hunted Forever
scenarios.desc: Since the start of the Cataclysm, they have been hunting you relentlessly.  You can try to fight them, but each time one falls another takes its place.  The only escape is for you to die.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Fungal Infection
scenarios.desc: You feel spores crawling beneath your skin.  It's only a matter of time.

scenarios.name: Burning Building
scenarios.desc: The building you had chosen to reside in has suddenly caught fire!  You might want to leave.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Unliving History
scenarios.desc: New England is dotted with old forts from the Revolutionary War, and many of them are still standing.  When things started getting really bad, it seemed like a natural place to hole up for a while, and it turns out that many, many other people had the same idea.  The peace didn't

scenarios.name: Challenge - Really Bad Day
scenarios.desc: You start drunk to the point of incapacitation, depressed, infected, surrounded by fire, and sick with the flu.  This day went downhill really fast.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Medieval Peasant
scenarios.desc: Som nigromancie hath brought yow hidder!  Ye have only the hoose on youre legges and the knyf at youre syde and youre prayeres to Marie moder of God.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Trans-Coast Logistics Concourse
scenarios.desc: You were deemed an essential employee and required to stay behind during the facility's evacuation.  You'd better find your lanyard with your badge before the automated defenses notice that you don't have one.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Trans-Coast Logistics Mutant
scenarios.desc: You were an experimental subject confined to a government black site.  While you were luckier than your fellow mutants, remaining somewhat human, you still bear many scars of the scientists' experiments.  Unfortunately, the facility has fallen to chaos, and everyone is either dea

scenarios.name: Challenge - Bordered
scenarios.desc: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  While evacuating, you noticed a mysterious sky-high wall in the distance, seemingly cutting off travel in every direction around you.

scenarios.name: Ambush
scenarios.desc: It is the winter after zero hour.  As you were scavenging for food and a warm place to stay, you heard the sound of lots of movement nearby.

scenarios.name: The Next Summer
scenarios.desc: A little over a year has passed since the apocalypse started, and you're about to face your second summer in Hell.

scenarios.name: 美丽新世界
scenarios.desc: It's been a year since the apocalypse, and winter is fast approaching.  You and your company have managed to gather up enough supplies to finally settle down somewhere, away from the death and destruction.  Life has been hard for you, but in your heart you still hold a vision of

scenarios.name: Sheltered
scenarios.desc: When the apocalypse broke out, you were evacuated to a small underground bunker.  Here you have lived, never leaving, lest the dangers of the unknown find you.  Supplies are running low, and for the first time since the Cataclysm, you will be forced to face the outside world.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Abandoned
scenarios.desc: Sickly and frail, you have spent most of your life in the patient's ward of various hospitals.  When your current one was evacuated, you were considered a lost cause and left behind.  You awaken to the sound of movement around the hospital.

scenarios.name: 监狱
scenarios.desc: When the Cataclysm happened, you were convicted or working in a prison.  Now the inmates and guards alike have turned into mindless horrors and joined forces… you might need to expedite your escape plans.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Island Prison
scenarios.desc: You were convicted or working in a high-security prison before the Cataclysm.  Unfortunately, you're still in it, so you need to figure out how to escape.  It's located on a remote island to boot; you'll eventually need to escape that also.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Mi-Go Camp
scenarios.desc: You have found yourself in the most alien place you've ever seen.  The hot, humid air and the organic appearance of the structure make you feel like you're trapped inside a giant creature.  Whatever it is, you need to get out of here before They find you.

scenarios.name: Experiment
scenarios.desc: You have been heavily experimented upon for the advancement of genetic science, willingly or not.  Once the Cataclysm struck, you escaped the lab and wandered aimlessly, ending up in a forest.

scenarios.name: The Mascot Rises
scenarios.desc: Business had been bad — for some reason, weeks of rioting, an evacuation order, and the sky breaking with alien shadows prompted a downturn in foot traffic, even among Foodplace's chain restaurants.  As an employee, upon evacuation being declared, you disregarded company orders t

scenarios.name: The Last Delivery
scenarios.desc: As the world was falling apart around you, something shook you out of your stupor: a phone call on Foodplace's excellent delivery service line.  It was the most incoherent babbling you've ever heard, but it was undeniably the biggest order you've seen in your years working at Foo

scenarios.name: Last Flight
scenarios.desc: Once it became clear that the world was ending you took to the skies, hoping that your flying skills could lead you to safety.  You found no standing safe zones, and when your fuel ran out, were forced to land in open field.

scenarios.name: Skyfarer's Landing
scenarios.desc: You once roamed the skies aboard your airship, trading and exploring above the clouds.  When the Cataclysm struck, you had no choice but to set down in unfamiliar territory.  The ground is dangerous, but the skies still belong to you.

scenarios.name: 野外生存
scenarios.desc: You find yourself among trees.  The screaming and moaning is fainter this far from civilization, but you'd better know what you're doing out here.

scenarios.name: Beach day
scenarios.desc: You do not remember why you went there but now you are at the beach.  It is nice to look at the waves and forget about the End Times.

scenarios.name: 直升机坠毁地
scenarios.desc: While being transported to a different military base, the pilot lost control of the helicopter and crashed in the middle of nowhere.  You seem to be the only survivor.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Bottom of a Mine
scenarios.desc: You were participating in a mining operation when you found… something.  You're not sure what, but it sure is dark down here.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Overrun
scenarios.desc: Despite all the soldiers, guns, and barbed wire, the military base you were in was overrun by the dead.  Everyone was ordered to fall back to the armory, but during all the chaos you got lost and you are now stuck in the warehouse by yourself.  You are not sure if anyone made it

scenarios.name: Crazy Party
scenarios.desc: You'd been unsurprised when your vacation — a hastily arranged holiday to a remote resort to maintain distance from the riots — had been put out of its misery when state-wide evacuation was ordered after weeks of worsening violence, and the complex had been placed on a shortlist

scenarios.name: Challenge - Car Crash
scenarios.desc: You decided the open road would be a better prospect than the zombie-filled cities.  While en route to your destination, you were involved in a crash that totaled your vehicle.  Injured and alone, you'll need to think fast if you want to survive.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Splintering Reality
scenarios.desc: You found yourself alone in an open field when reality began to heave and crack all around you.  You need to find shelter, and fast.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Stronger Portal Storms
scenarios.desc: You've managed to get to a shelter, but reality has grown weaker than normal, and portal storms will be quite strong.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Frequent Portal Storms
scenarios.desc: You've managed to get to a shelter, but reality has grown weaker than normal, and portal storms will be more frequent.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Portal Dependent
scenarios.desc: You were caught in a huge and unstable portal storm, and were utterly unprotected from the full force of its effects.  You're on the tail end of the storm now, and while you've survived, you feel… different.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Labyrinth Bound
scenarios.desc: During the worst of the portal storms you found yourself exposed, and existence as you knew it folded in upon itself.  You now find yourself lost in another world.  You're not sure if you'll ever be able to return.  But, there is something in the distance.  A green light?  Atop a

scenarios.name: Challenge - Mansion Escape
scenarios.desc: You were living the high life when the world ended, surrounded by riches and eating well every day.  Now you've woken up, alone and drugged, in a room of your mansion that you don't recognize.  As you fight to remain conscious, you hear heavy footsteps nearby.  Time to get the he

scenarios.name: Challenge - Compromised Shelter
scenarios.desc: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  However, the people you came with started to turn and now they're out for your flesh!  You've holed up in the basement for now, but sooner or later you h

scenarios.name: Challenge - Aircraft Carrier
scenarios.desc: You were on a mission off the coast of North Korea when the aircraft carrier you were stationed on suddenly and inexplicably found itself in the middle of a lake.  You have no idea where you are or what's happened, but you have more important things to worry about: everyone else

scenarios.name: Golden Years
scenarios.desc: After a lifetime of hard work, you managed to settle down in a posh retirement community.  You saw the riots on the news but assumed they would have no reason to attack some harmless old folks.  That assumption was proven wrong by a group of lunatics breaking in, leaving you no c

scenarios.name: Challenge - Emergency Shutdown
scenarios.desc: When the Cataclysm happened, you were working in a nuclear power plant.  Now you're trapped inside, surrounded by the shambling bodies of what used to be your coworkers.  The reactor's shut down, but you don't know if there's been a radiation leak and you need to get away from he

scenarios.name: Challenge - Close Encounter
scenarios.desc: You don't know what it was but you managed to lose it for the time being.  Now you are injured, surrounded and the building is on fire.  You hope you have some time before it returns to finish the job.

scenarios.name: Surrounded in the Dark
scenarios.desc: You were camping in the wild to let things back home cool off.  One night strange noises closed in on you and you were attacked.  You managed to get away but can feel things moving in the dark.

scenarios.name: Lone Survivor
scenarios.desc: You are the only one that made it.  Everyone else died nearby.  You have to get out of here!

scenarios.name: Challenge - Between a Rock and a Hard Place
scenarios.desc: You were trying to scavenge for supplies, and now some rough group of bandits has dragged monsters in with them where you were hiding!

scenarios.name: Challenge - Shattered Sky
scenarios.desc: From up here, you watched it all fall apart.  The sky cracked and indescribable alien shapes writhed in the clouds.  The horizon has returned to normal, but you still see shadows moving in the corner of your eye and feel them calling you.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Hunted by the Dead
scenarios.desc: Since the start of the Cataclysm, the air around you has felt different, like you pissed off whatever is causing the Cataclysm.  Now zombie hordes will approach you everywhere you go, regardless of whether they see you or not.

scenarios.name: Low Profile
scenarios.desc: You heard the global, worsening news and saw the nightmare in the cities firsthand — a situation that prompted you to jump from low-rent motel to cheap trailer, trying to outrun the madness.  While only you know where you'd planned to go, when you heard the government's last broa

scenarios.name: Mass Quarantine
scenarios.desc: When FEMA camps ran out of space the authorities used what was left of their manpower to round up people at gunpoint.  The stadiums they forced everyone into did nothing to slow down the madness and it spread like wildfire.  You managed to slip away from the worst violence but yo

scenarios.name: 无人区
scenarios.desc: During your escape you got lost and ended up at the wrong location.  Get your bearings and make a plan.  You'll need it.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Lost Underground
scenarios.desc: When the riots came to your home, you ran underground and hid.  Now days later you are lost and hear movement echoing in the dark.

scenarios.name: Challenge - Last Stand
scenarios.desc: Together with some others you decided to take up arms against the horde.  Now you are reconsidering whether that was a wise choice.

scenarios.name: A Moonlight Night
scenarios.desc: You've been holed up in your basement ever since the Cataclysm happened a little over a week ago, but now you've run out of food and have been forced to go on a supply run on this fateful moonlit night.  You see zombies all around you, but thankfully, most of them can't seem to s

scenarios.name: University Student
scenarios.desc: You stayed in the residence hall after classes were canceled.  The campus is quiet now, and you have your room, your books and whatever you can carry.
